{"metadata":{"description":"Per-edit approval gate for DeepSeek Harness — red/green line diff review before write/edit/stream operations · DSH 插件：逐操作审批门，write/edit/stream 执行前进行红绿行级 diff 审查","id":"gh:1336675373","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-edit-approval","slug":"SiriLee/dsh-edit-approval","topics":["approval","client-plugin","code-review","cordis","deepseek-harness","diff","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-market","dsh-plugins","editing","gate","plugin","review","safety","ui"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Per-edit approval gate for DeepSeek Harness — red/green line diff review before write/edit/stream op"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"erations · DSH 插件：逐操作审批门，write/edit/stream 执行前进行红绿行级 diff 审查"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-edit-approval"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Ask-before-act approval for DeepSeek Harness: **every `write` / `edit` call asks before the file is "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"touched — a red/green line-level diff, approve once or reject — and every `bash` command asks before"},{"id":"p3s3","text":" it runs**, each with its own master switch on the plugin's own page under **Plugins** in the sideba"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"t runs**, each with its own master switch on the plugin's own page under **Plugins** in the sidebar."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> English | 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"A deliberately focused plugin with **two mirror-symmetric approval gates** — edits and commands — so"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" the agent can never modify files or run commands without your say-so."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| Gate | Intercepts | Default | Panel |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| **Edit approval** | `write` / `edit` (`str_replace_editor` on request) | On | Red/green line-level"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" diff — approve once or reject |
| **Bash approval** | `bash` | Off | Description headline + native "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ve once or reject |
| **Bash approval** | `bash` | Off | Description headline + native command row |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Both gates ride the harness's own `serviceAsk` seam: the plugin returns `{ kind: 'ask', reason }` fr"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"om `tools/pre-execute`, the harness routes it into the web approval panel — **zero UI changes in the"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" host** — `allowed-once` proceeds, `rejected` denies the call, and under the `never` policy the plug"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"in delegates so full-access sessions keep working."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Preview"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Every write-family call shows the red/green diff panel; after you enable command approval, every com"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"mand shows a panel whose white headline is the agent's description and whose grey row is the raw com"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"mand text. Both master switches live on this bundle's page in the sidebar's **Plugins** panel, stage"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"d through the harness's own form (captured on v0.4.0)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Edit approval panel — red/green line diff"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Bash approval panel — description + command"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Master switches on the bundle's page in the sidebar's Plugins panel"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"/approval-edit and /approval-bash commands"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Restart `dsh web` (`--profile web`) after installing."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"For contributors: install from a local checkout or a pinned commit — `dsh plugin --profile web add /"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"path/to/dsh-edit-approval` or `dsh plugin --profile web add github:SiriLee/dsh-edit-approval#<sha>` "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"— or from an offline tarball (`npm pack` then `dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-edit-approval-<ver"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"sion>.tgz`). A git install fails on first run until you add an `allowBuilds` key to the profile's `p"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"npm-workspace.yaml` (pnpm blocks git dependencies from running build scripts); after that it runs th"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"e plugin's `prepare` and installs it. `npm pack` also runs `prepare`, so a tarball always carries a "},{"id":"p18s7","text":"prebuilt `lib/` (with `.d.ts`) and the `LICENSE`."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The plugin listens on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall (the seam the harness runs before a tool exe"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"cutes) and dispatches to one of two gates by tool name — edits win on overlap."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## What it deliberately does NOT do"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Escape or expand sandboxing** — it never changes the sandbox mode or grants access; escalation c"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"alls pass through to the sandbox's own approval.
- **Intercept inside commands** — file edits perfor"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"med *inside* a `bash` command are not edit-gated (they are covered by command approval, when enabled"},{"id":"p22s4","text":").
- **Partial application** — the diff is a read-only preview (`+` / `-` line markers); "apply only"},{"id":"p22s5","text":" some lines" is not supported.
- **Ask about calls the tool itself would fail on** — e.g. `str_repla"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"ce_editor create` against an existing file, a non-unique or missing `old_str` / `old_string`; they p"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"ass through for the tool to report. An empty `old_string` `edit` preview deviates from the tool (tre"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"ated as not-found) — safe, it never falsely blocks.
- **Keyboard shortcuts** (Enter to approve / Esc"},{"id":"p22s9","text":" to reject) — split into the dedicated dsh-approval-hotkeys plugin.
- **Post-edit review / rollback*"},{"id":"p22s10","text":"* — covered by the community dsh-change-review.
- **Permission-tier extensions** — covered by the co"},{"id":"p22s11","text":"mmunity dsh-auto-approval-plugin."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.
- DeepSeek Harness web profile (`dsh --profile web`); `@deepseek-a"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"i/*` packages are resolved by the harness at runtime, never fetched by this package.
- **The DSH `0."},{"id":"p24s3","text":"2.0` line only** — verified against `0.2.0-rc.1`, the version this release pins in `devDependencies`"},{"id":"p24s4","text":". Declared as a single `^0.2.0-rc.1` peer tuple per harness package, with `engines.dsh = ">=0.2.0-rc"},{"id":"p24s5","text":".1"`. The plugin tracks one DSH line at a time and drops the previous one when the line moves: this "},{"id":"p24s6","text":"range admits `0.2.0-rc.1` through `0.2.x` (a same-tuple prerelease roll needs no peer change), while"},{"id":"p24s7","text":" `0.1.7-rc.2` and `0.3.0-rc.1` are skipped at startup with a peer diagnostic instead of loading the "},{"id":"p24s8","text":"bundle into a half-broken state.
- `node scripts/check-dsh-version.mjs` watches the release cadence:"},{"id":"p24s9","text":" it verifies the declaration is internally consistent (one tuple across every harness peer, engine f"},{"id":"p24s10","text":"loor in sync) and reports when DSH publishes above the declared window.
- **Why one line.** DSH 0.1."},{"id":"p24s11","text":"7 replaced the settings-namespace registry this plugin used for both features with one live `Config`"},{"id":"p24s12","text":" per profile entry, and removed the browser `dsh-client-runtime` package and the `settingsScope` ser"},{"id":"p24s13","text":"vice. There is no 1:1 successor for the old model, so keeping an older line as well would mean maint"},{"id":"p24s14","text":"aining two settings models, two client write paths and two session-read shapes. The full seam-by-sea"},{"id":"p24s15","text":"m record — including which failures were silent — is in docs/compat/0.1.7-audit.md.
